# EHA Workflows

When a user asks to run an EHA workflow, use the matching prompt file below.

- `help` → `.github/skills/eha-help/SKILL.md`
- `bootstrap` → `.github/skills/eha-bootstrap/SKILL.md`
- `refresh` → `.github/skills/eha-refresh/SKILL.md`
- `discuss` → `.github/skills/eha-discuss/SKILL.md`
- `sdd-execute` → `.github/skills/eha-sdd-execute/SKILL.md`
- `execute-phase` → `.github/skills/eha-execute-phase/SKILL.md`
